newsitem.title: INDIA: India's PM moves vote of confidence.
newsitem.headline: India's PM moves vote of confidence.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda on Friday moved a parliamentary vote of confidence in his 10-month-old government.

"It is left to the house to take a decision according to their own conscience about the vote of confidence," Deve Gowda said at the end of a speech that concluded 12-1/2 hours of debate in the lower house of parliament.
Deve Gowda was almost certain to lose the vote as both the Congress party and the Bharatiya Janata Party, with 333 votes in the 542-member lower house, had already said they would vote against him.
The speaker of the house, P.A. Sangma, later asked members to cast their votes.
